Product Overview

Upgrade your 2007-2010 Chevrolet Silverado or GMC Sierra 2500HD/3500HD with this Advanced Series Bull Guard featuring a built-in LED light bar and switch. Finished in a rugged matte black, this bull guard delivers serious front-end protection while adding aggressive, functional lighting to your heavy-duty truck.

  • Advanced Series Construction: Heavy-duty steel build engineered for maximum front-end protection on 2500HD and 3500HD trucks
  • Built-In LED Light Bar: Integrated LED light bar provides powerful auxiliary lighting without additional mounting hardware
  • Included Switch: Dedicated on/off switch included for convenient LED light bar control
  • Matte Black Finish: Durable matte black powder coat resists rust, corrosion, and UV fading
  • Direct-Fit Design: Engineered specifically for 2007-2010 Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra HD models for a clean, factory-style installation
  • Dual-Purpose Functionality: Combines front-end brush guard protection with integrated lighting in a single unit
